title: Ali Is Sick
text:
Ali has a headache. He takes a pill and drinks water. He goes to bed early. His mother is worried.

In the morning, Ali feels fine. He eats breakfast with his family. Then he goes to school. He is happy again.

questions.text: Where does Ali go in the morning?
How does Ali probably feel at the end of the story?

vocabulary.definition: a small round medicine that you swallow with water
feeling afraid that something bad may happen
the first meal of the day, eaten in the morning

paragraph_translations: Ali'nin baş ağrısı var. Bir hap alır ve su içer. Erken yatağa gider. Annesi endişeli.
Sabah Ali kendini iyi hisseder. Ailesiyle birlikte kahvaltı yapar. Sonra okula gider. Yeniden mutludur.
